text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —HAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...It's here.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's just... it's just so incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yoicho――maru!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wonder if Helios is gonna
tear it up today~

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if all goes as expected,
I feel like... I could totally do it, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I mean, don't you like Daiichi Ruby? Since she's not around, feels like your motivation's kinda tanked too...

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
...Helios,
I seriously can't read you at all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Milers Cup...
Just as she had said,
Daitaku Helios was acting strangely.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You have no idea!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't I look different from usual today!? Look, look~!
choice_data_list: ...Did you subtly change your colored contacts?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I changed it!!
It's the same color, but a different brand!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome!
Trainy, you love me way too much, don'tcha~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“No, no, that's not it at aall!
Take a closer look!”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Am I—
totally slaying or what!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
I said it out loud☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's so true~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, I woke up totally yoichomaru,
and the hype energy is just flowin' around!?
choice_data_list: Looks like you're going to put on an incredible run.
Looks like you're going to put on an incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can only feel my party level going up!
Today's totally god-tier—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If it shines too bright!!
Ruby won't be able to look away either!!"
